newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products weakened by crude, poor demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products weakened by crude, poor demand.

text.p: Gas oil shed $2.75 a tonne on weaker futures on Wednesday. Lack of buying kept downward pressure on barge and cargo premiums.
Gasoline barges fell $1 in very quiet trade with weaker NYMEX prices staining arbitrage interest.
Naphtha ended unchanged but anticipated rising supply of cargoes and weak end-user demand were expected to weigh on physical prices.
Fuel oil lost further ground with demand for both high and low sulphur material fairly sparse.
